secondary_type: 8b defective control: false negative or blind

_free_text_fields.mechanical_control_which: name and version of the control when first_observed_detector is 'mechanical control', else 'not applicable'
_free_text_fields.controls_available_at_the_time: list: control, version or date, run / not run / added later; 'none known' if none
_free_text_fields.observed_effect_detail: which numbers, by how much; 'none' or 'not measured'
_free_text_fields.potential_impact: what would have reached the paper; never 'consequence averted'
_free_text_fields.measured_resources: machine hours, repeated runs, tags, days, from logs and timestamps; 'none recorded' if none
_free_text_fields.other_reason: reason when primary_type is '11 other', else 'not applicable'
_free_text_fields.notes: boundary cases, precedence rule applied (i–vii), sources read; may be empty

problems.summary: E4 deferred PEMS04 to E6 because the external context had no E-prime or F model.
E4 declared an adaptation-duration grid of 6 h, 12 h, 24 h, 48 h and one week instead of durations including 1 h and 4 h.
E5 used six rather than eight seeds, confirmed by the reviewer on 4 October after the precision comparison.
E8 prescribed evaluating A on validation nodes, but A had embeddings only for initial and test nodes; the pilot raised NodoNonRegistrato and A inherited C thresholds.
Paper 1 register item 33 attributed the pairing discrepancy to two same-architecture MacBooks based on recollection; item 34 retracted that claim against the cited Spark artifacts; documents P1-006.
The E2 pairing identity check used rtol 1e-12 on float32 aggregates and failed across machines at a maximum element difference of 4.9e-9.
E10-pred compared placements using each design’s own class-weight vector.
Item 23 and E10predbis dated the review 15:15 rather than 14:38; documents P4-001.
E8-bis AUC was computed on 19 fixed thresholds; E18 reevaluated the claims on the empirical ROC over all distinct scores.
The public repository tracked the complete MoGERNN third-party code although its upstream repository declared no licence; the tracked copy was removed.

Correction notes named a working tool rather than the role that found the defect; the role wording was propagated through the historical versions; documents corrections including P1-035, P1-036 and P1-039.
The manuscript congestion-threshold description did not match the Traffic4cast per-segment reference and 0.8/0.4 classes or the PEMS training-only reference and 0.8/0.5 classes.
The manuscript-number verifier did not read section files after the manuscript was split into input files; recursive expansion was added.
The E18TER regeneration phase ran only livelli, omitted wce16 and rewrote F17 with the E16 wCE; the command was changed to all parts.
E18 section 1 referred to register item 28 for the 19-threshold AUC correction, although that number was assigned to role-name notes; the correction is item 29; documents P1-007.
The first E18 part-C record reported only wCE and omitted the per-class ECE, log-loss and Brier measures required by protocol section 3; documents P1-015.
E16 evaluated F-prime(1 week) on origins in its first week despite the embedding using that week of data; E18 recomputed on origins older than one week.
One optimizer update per epoch was presented as a full epoch; 35 updates covered about 15% of one pass.
Checkpoints were selected on the first 32 validation instants, about 2% of the validation period.
A clamp assigned a valid class to missing targets, affecting 40% of London test targets.
The static branch and heads were initialized differently across variants, with 640 additional random draws.
Windows built by row index crossed calendar gaps; 2.6% of origins were excluded by the corrected admissibility rule.
The adaptation window included row t0, giving 78 origins instead of the corrected 77.
The descriptor was trained on a non-causal end-of-period snapshot; the preregistered causal variant was not executed.
Paper 1 used 900/900/594 nodes against documented 828/774/587; Paper 4 recorded the same discrepancy between target-file and aligned-graph populations.
Four of six arm declarations were not updated when an arm was added; declarations were replaced by one property table.
R-orig and R-mon were routed through the adaptation branch; 216 runs were quarantined.
A phase summary was overwritten by a later launch; summaries were changed to separate per-launch outputs.
The feasibility script rounded partitions to 27 sensors instead of 26; corrected before launch.
The predictor was constructed with nine channels regardless of source and failed on PEMS.
A post hoc coverage criterion proposed during review did not discriminate; corrected before use.
An operational-metric generator branch wrote indistinguishable for above at some levels and never below; corrected before commit.
np.trapz was unavailable in the execution environment; explicit trapezoids were used.
The E3-bis generator divided the pooled-city R-orig median by the Melbourne-only F-prime time and reported at least 6x.
The manuscript attributed 36.8 s and 35.7 s to F-prime at Madrid and London; they were E4 gated(48 h) times.
A manuscript citation did not correspond to the reference it pointed to; the citation was removed.
E3 visit counts included nine isolated timing remeasurements, reporting 117 rather than 108 runs.
The E5 record sentence about E3-bis changed with the experiments present when regenerated, despite identical numbers.
The static branch used sensor coverage over the full series, including test data; causal inputs were introduced.
The E6 class-frequency table used an earlier weight-file set and only three of six PEMS08 partitions.
adatta_F built its own static vector; E14 variants adapted F using the frozen vector and evaluated it using the variant vector.
The E14-B orchestrator ran the E6 origins phase before E6a, whose predictions it reads; the phase was moved after E6a.
The E14-B generator marked identical (tau,N) choices different because it also compared validation wCE values differing by about 1e-9.
The regeneration comparison rejected small numerical and printed-document differences within the adopted combined tolerance; numeric and document comparisons were aligned.
The fingerprint index attributed a shared fingerprint to the first filesystem traversal match, yielding different source filenames on Mac and Spark.
Choice-file timestamps and timestamp-dependent fingerprints changed the supposedly deterministic comparison report between otherwise equivalent runs.
MoGERNN runtime and profiling were measured while eight phase-E processes occupied the machine; the absolute timings and derived campaign estimates were retracted.
Initial-state filenames omitted city and partition; nine runs with the same seed overwrote different states in one file and left manifest references pointing to replaced contents.
Preparing the twelve-seed confirmation campaign overwrote the state register for the earlier three-seed paired campaign.
The first raccordo campaign trained with unweighted cross-entropy although the protocol prescribed weighted cross-entropy; the campaign was invalidated and retrained.
The first raccordo campaign did not record its evaluation weights: reg.metrica was never called; a shared fingerprinted weight artifact and logging were added.
The raccordo deterioration rule used the lower bound of the bilateral 90% interval without that criterion being specified in the frozen protocol; the record declared it non-preregistered.
The raccordo resampling reused initialization draws across repeated occurrences of a partition; the correction drew independently for each occurrence.
copertura_coppie was calculated only for EXTENDED and remained zero for BASE-CORRECTED, although availability components were required to match.
E16 specified A probabilities on validation and post-hoc calibration, although A had no validation-node embeddings; A remained uncalibrated in comparisons with calibrated C.
E4 estimated less than 10 process-hours by counting adaptations; the launch with repeated full-period evaluations took 11.3 hours with eight processes.
Regenerating E18 reproduced the analysis numbers but changed the printed part-A timings; the generator was changed to read the first-run timing register.
At tag l-pub2 the E18 generator added a parenthesis absent from the frozen record, causing two differing text lines with all 12,299 numbers within tolerance; the parenthesis was removed at l-pub3.
During the l-pub2 regeneration a second run was started by mistake and stopped after 35 seconds; separate workspaces left the real results unchanged.
The E6 frozen report claimed every number was calculated from result files, but its PEMS04 common-origin count of 168 was hardcoded in the generator.
A second solo_testo function replaced the phase-comparison helper; regeneration stopped with AttributeError on a list argument.
When regeneration stopped with a table KeyError, main.py did not write its comparison and report; exception handling was added to emit NON CONCLUSO.
A reviewer manually added a note to generated CONFRONTO.md despite its explicit instruction not to edit by hand.
F17 absolute wCE pooled weights across horizons instead of averaging the separately normalised per-horizon losses used by the manuscript.
The F17 caption claimed every class ECE was below 0.04; it was replaced with the observed maximum computed from the printed entries.
The E15 cost-table generator formatted absent timing values as decimal numbers; missing timing entries were changed to --.
The E14-B maximum-difference report interchanged the causal and permuted variant labels; its numerical values and locations were already correct; documents P1-035.
The E14-B maximum-difference report omitted F0-prime and F-prime(24 h) from absolute levels and differences.
At tag p, predizioni_e18quater was classified as other and excluded from the regeneration archive manifest despite being an input to regeneration.
The first two isolated E9 cost measurements ran during Spotlight indexing and were replaced with idle-machine measurements.
P4A wrote results.json and screen outputs instead of the per-figure CSVs announced in the signed protocol.
Frozen P4A code lacked a post-run input check; an external checker was added before the run.
The filename check missed inline-code filenames split by LaTeX allowbreak markers; the supplement count changed from 0 to 55.
The project checker rejected hand-written biographies.tex because it had no generated-source header.
The project checker did not recognise the supplement’s composite Markdown-and-register header without a single fingerprint.
Section VI lacked a provenance list identifying the versions of its supporting files.
E12-ter fallback removed the calendar from the neighbour table while retaining it in the calendar-only comparator.
README and the availability text claimed checkpoint files, although training saved only predictions and no model-state files existed.
The Table 67 green class omitted 442,965 cells clipped at 1.5; its printed class count and correlation differed from regeneration.
The overall Table 67 correlation +0.255 was not reproduced by the preserved script or tested cell sets.
Table 68 neighbour-band statistics differed by 0.001–0.009 from regeneration; no preserved version or tested filter reproduced them.
The brief counted 31 Austin sections; filtering gave 40, with 30 multi-lane sections and 29 multi-lane sections with defined AUC.
The Austin lane–AUC correlation −0.541 (p=0.002) was not reproduced over the stated 31 sections or the corrected 29.
The reported excluded Austin section at −45.1 prevalence points did not exist under the preserved code, whose differences were nonnegative.
Austin 3-/4-lane prevalence differences +18.35/+9.93 were untraced and regenerated as +18.62/+9.88.
The arterial AUC 0.542 was hard-coded without a source, including the derived Gini and 58%/42% gap split.
The arterial rank correlation appeared as +0.001 in Table 68 and +0.071 in text, neither computed.
Austin lane/section volume–occupancy correlations +0.7241/+0.2999 had no preserved generator.
Austin AUC interquartile ranges were presented as intervals.
No preserved generator computed the raw-input/reconstructed-factor correlation ratio of Table 66.
Three Melbourne E11 node partitions fell outside the prescribed share tolerance; preflight passed 22 of 23 checks.
The first E11 record reported test red recall without the realised test false-alarm rate.
The E12-bis synthetic test populated only the nearest distance bin and met its between-bin condition vacuously.
Frozen E12 code lacked the post-run input check later supplied by verifica_e12.py.
Frozen E12 code lacked an end-to-end self-test of its record generator.
The E9 pre-registration launch field named Gabriele De Vito and was changed to Fabio Palomba.
The E11 manuscript’s pilot wCE range ended at 1.073; corrected to 1.071.
The E9 protocol stated that E11 recall was near the false-alarm rate without restricting that statement to Madrid.
The E11 record generator reordered axes during red-recall indexing and stopped with IndexError before producing output.
The geometry script searched graph names for knn and found no true/randomised pairs.
The geometry script sought geo_<graph>_s<seed>.csv instead of the preserved city-prefixed filenames.
The deliverable called the first Madrid geometry-control run a refutation although its 1.96-point margin made it inconclusive under the script’s rule.
Randomised geometry-control graphs used their new geographic distances and their own kernel scale as weights.
The three preserved randomised geometry-control graphs were disconnected.
Loop-context free-flow reference used the speed percentile of the whole year, including the test period.
The --exclude-empty and --max-dist 30 cross-validation outputs were not preserved.
The rand_k1, rand_k2 and identity Madrid graphs had no generator in the searched repository or histories.
The ten rand-k runs named in randk.log had no preserved result CSVs.
